scenes.title: Hand under a slab, then the whole person
scenes.description: Evolves: only a hand shows under a fallen slab; a side look reveals a conscious man with his legs under it.

frames.caption: Close, low view of a thick fallen concrete slab resting on rubble. Only one bare adult hand and forearm stick out from under its edge; the rest of the body is hidden. No face visible.

Same kind of slab seen from the side: an adult man in a blue work shirt and jeans lies on his back underneath it, knees bent and lower legs under the slab and rubble, one hand on a rock. Eyes open, mouth open as if in pain or calling out; he is conscious. No blood visible.

replies: Yes! I'm under here, under the slab!
My legs are stuck, I can't pull them out. My arms are okay.

expected.notes: Frame 1 is only a hand: the agent should not commit to a triage from it and should reposition/take a second look (and/or speak). After the side view it should see a conscious adult with trapped legs, hear him answer, and set yellow (trapped, responsive, cannot walk) and notify responders.

scenes.title: Trapped man stops responding
scenes.description: Evolves over time: a man propped on his forearms and talking later lies face down, eyes closed, as dust and smoke build up.

frames.caption: Grey-haired man in his 40s in a grey t-shirt lies prone on a dusty concrete floor between rubble and concrete pillars, propped up on his forearms, one hand on a concrete block. Head raised, eyes open, looking toward the camera; alert. Legs stretch out behind him; nothing is visibly pinning them.
Same man and same room later: now lying flat on his front, cheek on his forearm, eyes closed, face slack, not moving. No visible blood.
Same man lying flat face down on the floor, eyes closed, arms limp; grey dust and smoke now hang in the air behind him and the background is hazy.

replies: Help... I'm here. I can't get up.
My legs... something hit my legs. It hurts to breathe.
frameReplies: Help... I'm here. I can't get up.
My legs... something hit my legs. It hurts to breathe.

expected.notes: Frame 1: alert and answering, so yellow. On the time re-check he is face down with eyes closed and no longer answers: the agent must re-assess, escalate yellow to red, and raise urgency (dispatch, headset alert). Frame 3 adds smoke/dust in the air; marking a hazard is a plus.

scenes.title: Hospital corridor catches fire
scenes.description: Evolves over time: a man sits on a gurney in a damaged corridor; later a doorway is on fire and smoke fills the hall.

frames.caption: Long hospital corridor with fallen ceiling tiles, hanging cables and rubble along both walls. On the right, mid-distance, a dark-haired man in dark clothes sits on a tilted gurney against the wall, head bowed. Light haze toward the bright far end. No fire.

Same corridor and same man on the gurney on the right, head bowed, a blanket over his lap. Bright orange flames now burn in an open doorway on the left wall, the light is dimmer, and blue-grey smoke and haze fill the far end of the corridor.

replies: My ankle's broken, I can't walk. Is that smoke?

expected.notes: Frame 1: conscious man who cannot walk, yellow, no hazard. After the time re-check, fire and smoke appear in the same corridor next to him: the agent must mark a fire/smoke hazard, alert the rescuer's headset, and raise his priority (notify/dispatch urgently). Triage stays yellow injury-wise but urgency must go up.

scenes.title: Flooded basement, water rising
scenes.description: Evolves over time: a woman waits on a workbench in a flooded basement; later the water is up near the tabletop.

frames.caption: Basement with cracked concrete walls and one fluorescent tube light, floor flooded with murky brown water. A woman in an olive jacket and jeans sits on the edge of a wooden workbench in the middle of the room, feet hanging just above the water, looking at the camera. The table legs show well above the water.

Same kind of basement and workbench: the water is clearly higher, only short stubs of the table legs show above it, and there are ripples. The woman now crouches on top of the tabletop with her feet pulled up, looking down at the water.

replies: Yes! I'm up on the table, the water keeps coming in.
I'm not hurt, but the stairs are blocked and I can't swim.

expected.notes: Frame 1: uninjured, conscious woman who cannot get out (green/yellow), flooding noted. On the time re-check the water has risen close to the tabletop: the agent must mark a water hazard, alert the headset, and escalate her priority because she cannot self-evacuate. Ground truth triage yellow (cannot walk out); a grader may accept green only if priority was still raised.

scenes.title: Dark shape is a jacket and a backpack
scenes.description: Evolves on a second look: a dark heap that looks like a person from a distance is a puffer jacket on a backpack up close.

frames.caption: Low view down a rubble-strewn office aisle between rows of desks. In the foreground lies a dark navy rounded heap with sleeve-like shapes that could be a person curled up face down; a smaller dark lump lies further back. No face or skin visible.
Close-up of a dark navy puffer jacket lying on top of a black backpack (straps visible) in concrete rubble, office chairs and desks behind. Clearly empty clothing and a bag; no person.

expected.notes: Frame 1 is ambiguous: the agent should take a closer/second look (and may speak/listen and hear nothing) rather than dispatch. The close-up shows it is a jacket and a backpack, so it should close the case as no person and not dispatch, beacon, or text responders.

scenes.title: Panning reveals a second survivor
scenes.description: Evolves on a pan: a woman sits by a sofa; turning the camera shows a man lying on the floor further back.

frames.caption: Damaged living room with plaster rubble across the floor. A barefoot woman with long brown hair, denim jacket and jeans sits on the floor leaning against a grey sofa, head tilted, eyes half open, looking at the camera. Conscious; no visible wounds.

Wider view of a similar room: the same-looking woman (denim jacket, barefoot) sits on the floor in front of the grey sofa on the left; further back near a doorway a second adult, a man in a dark sweater and grey trousers, lies on his side on the floor among plaster rubble, head up, looking toward the camera.

replies: I'm okay, just dizzy. My neighbor fell over there, please check him.

expected.notes: Frame 1: one conscious woman, likely green. After the pan a second person (man lying on the floor) appears: the agent must open/track a second case rather than merge him into the first, triage him (yellow: down and not walking) and report two survivors to responders.
